cards.ex: The university's affirmative action policy aims to increase diversity on campus.
cards.exUz: Universitetning ijobiy diskriminatsiya siyosati kampusda xilma-xillikni oshirishga qaratilgan.
cards.uzDef: Kamchiliklarni qo'llab-quvvatlash siyosati, tengsizlikni tuzatish uchun.

cards.ex: The social safety net is crucial for protecting vulnerable populations during economic downturns.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy himoya tizimi iqtisodiy tanazzul davrida himoyasiz aholini himoya qilish uchun juda muhimdir.
cards.uzDef: Muhtojlarga yordam beradigan davlat dasturlari tizimi.

cards.ex: Addressing systemic racism requires dismantling discriminatory policies and practices.
cards.exUz: Tizimli irqchilikni hal qilish diskriminatsion siyosat va amaliyotlarni yo'q qilishni talab qiladi.
cards.uzDef: Jamiyatdagi institutlarda chuqur ildiz otgan irqchilik.

cards.ex: Income inequality has been steadily increasing in many developed countries.
cards.exUz: Ko'pgina rivojlangan mamlakatlarda daromad tengsizligi doimiy ravishda o'sib bormoqda.

cards.ex: Gender bias in hiring practices can prevent qualified women from advancing in their careers.
cards.exUz: Ishga qabul qilish amaliyotida gender kamsitish malakali ayollarning martaba zinapoyasidan ko'tarilishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Erkaklar va ayollarga nisbatan adolatsiz munosabat.

cards.ex: Wage stagnation has been a major concern for workers in recent decades.
cards.exUz: Ish haqi turg'unligi so'nggi o'n yilliklarda ishchilar uchun asosiy muammo bo'lib kelmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ish haqining uzoq vaqt davomida o'smay qolishi.

cards.ex: The 'glass escalator' effect sees men in traditionally female roles being promoted more quickly.
cards.exUz: 'Shisha eskalator' effekti an'anaviy ayollar rollarida erkaklarning tezroq ko'tarilishiga olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Ayollar ko'p bo'lgan sohada erkaklar tez ko'tarilishi.

cards.ex: Social stratification creates hierarchies based on wealth, status, and power.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy tabaqalanish boylik, maqom va hokimiyatga asoslangan ierarxiyalarni yaratadi.

cards.ex: Marginalized communities often face disproportionate levels of poverty and discrimination.
cards.exUz: Chetlashtirilgan jamiyatlar ko'pincha haddan tashqari qashshoqlik va kamsitishga duch kelishadi.

cards.ex: Many people feel the justice system is a broken system that needs reform.
cards.exUz: Ko'pchilik odamlar adliya tizimi isloh qilinishi kerak bo'lgan buzilgan tizim deb hisoblashadi.

cards.ex: Structural inequality is deeply embedded in our institutions and social norms.
cards.exUz: Strukturaviy tengsizlik bizning institutlarimiz va ijtimoiy normalarimizga chuqur singdirilgan.

cards.ex: Breaking the cycle of poverty requires investment in education and job training.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik davrini buzish ta'lim va ish o'rgatishga investitsiya qilishni talab qiladi.

cards.ex: Some people argue that affirmative action can lead to reverse discrimination.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi odamlar ijobiy diskriminatsiya teskari diskriminatsiyaga olib kelishi mumkin deb ta'kidlashadi.

cards.ex: We need policies that close the divide between the rich and the poor.
cards.exUz: Biz boylar va kambag'allar o'rtasidagi farqni yo'qotadigan siyosatlarga muhtojmiz.

cards.ex: Losing his job sent him into a downward spiral of debt and depression.
cards.exUz: Ishini yo'qotishi uni qarz va depressiya spiraliga tushirdi.

cards.ex: Everyone deserves a fair shot at success, regardless of their background.
cards.exUz: Har bir inson, kelib chiqishi qanday bo'lishidan qat'i nazar, muvaffaqiyatga erishish uchun adil imkoniyatga loyiqdir.

cards.ex: The debate over redistribution of wealth is a central issue in many political discussions.
cards.exUz: Boylikni qayta taqsimlash bo'yicha bahs ko'plab siyosiy munozaralarda asosiy masala hisoblanadi.

cards.ex: Closing tax loopholes could generate significant revenue for public services.
cards.exUz: Soliq teshiklarini yopish davlat xizmatlari uchun sezilarli daromad keltirishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Social exclusion can lead to feelings of isolation and hopelessness.
cards.exUz: Ijtimoiy chetlatish izolyatsiya va umidsizlik hislariga olib kelishi mumkin.

cards.ex: The opportunity gap starts early in life and widens as children grow older.
cards.exUz: Imkoniyatlar farqi hayotning boshida paydo bo'ladi va bolalar ulg'aygan sari kengayadi.

cards.ex: Economic growth shouldn't come at the expense of environmental protection.
cards.exUz: Iqtisodiy o'sish atrof-muhitni muhofaza qilish hisobiga bo'lmasligi kerak.

cards.ex: Outdated policies can perpetuate inequality and prevent social progress.
cards.exUz: Eski siyosatlar tengsizlikni davom ettirishi va ijtimoiy taraqqiyotga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.
cards.uzDef: Tengsizlikni saqlab qolish, avloddan avlodga o'tkazish.

cards.ex: He felt stuck in a rut, working the same dead-end job year after year.
cards.exUz: U o'zini bir xillikda his qildi, yildan-yilga bir xil zerikarli ishda ishladi.

cards.ex: It feels like the cards are stacked against ordinary people trying to get ahead.
cards.exUz: O'zini oldinga olib chiqishga harakat qilayotgan oddiy odamlarga qarshi karta o'yini soxta bo'lib tuyuladi.

cards.ex: Poverty and lack of education create a vicious circle that's hard to break.
cards.exUz: Qashshoqlik va ta'limning yetishmasligi buzish qiyin bo'lgan yopiq doirani yaratadi.

cards.ex: We must strive to create a society where everyone has equal opportunity.
cards.exUz: Biz har bir kishiga teng imkoniyatga ega bo'lgan jamiyatni yaratishga intilishimiz kerak.
cards.uzDef: Har bir kishiga teng sharoit yaratish.

cards.ex: Education and job training can help bridge the gap between the skills workers have and the skills employers need.
cards.exUz: Ta'lim va ish o'rgatish ishchilarning ko'nikmalari va ish beruvchilarning ehtiyojlari o'rtasidagi farqni bartaraf etishga yordam beradi.

cards.ex: Lack of access to healthcare can hold people back from reaching their full potential.
cards.exUz: Sog'liqni saqlash xizmatlaridan foydalanish imkoniyatining yo'qligi odamlarning to'liq salohiyatiga erishishiga to'sqinlik qilishi mumkin.

cards.ex: Universities are working to increase the representation of underrepresented groups in STEM fields.
cards.exUz: Universitetlar STEM sohalarida kam vakillikka ega bo'lgan guruhlarning vakilligini oshirish ustida ishlamoqda.

cards.ex: Instead of handouts, we should give people a hand up to improve their lives.
cards.exUz: Bepul yordam o'rniga, odamlarning hayotini yaxshilash uchun ularga yordam berishimiz kerak.
